Project South documents detail alleged police corruption and criminal links

Court documents related to "Project South" have revealed extensive alleged police corruption and criminal involvement. Allegations include an officer selling police uniforms to alleged criminals and a plot to kill an Ontario jail guard. The documents suggest a significant scale of corruption within the police force, with details emerging about the alleged criminal activities and the extent of the conspiracy. The reporting highlights new information that sheds light on the alleged criminal enterprise and its connections.
